subtitle: 以指定句子開頭，寫一個找貓的小故事
task: Write a short story that begins with this sentence: "When I got home from school, our cat was not on the sofa."
taskZh: 寫一篇短篇故事，以這句話開頭：「我放學回到家時，我們家的貓不在沙發上。」
focus: 用 Finally、That night 等時間詞串連

en: When I got home from school, our cat was not on the sofa. Lucky always sleeps there in the afternoon, so I knew something was wrong. I looked under the beds and in the kitchen, but she was not there.
I ran outside and called her name. My neighbor, Mrs. Chen, said she saw a gray cat in the park. I went to the park and searched everywhere for an hour.
Finally, I heard a small sound from a tree. Lucky was sitting on a high branch, too scared to come down. I climbed up slowly and carried her home.
That night, I closed every window. I was so happy to have her back!
zh: 我放學回到家時，我們家的貓不在沙發上。Lucky 下午總是睡在那裡，所以我知道一定出事了。我找了床底下和廚房，但她都不在。
我跑到外面叫她的名字。鄰居陳太太說她在公園看到一隻灰貓。我跑到公園，到處找了一個小時。
最後，我聽到樹上傳來一個細小的聲音。Lucky 坐在很高的樹枝上，害怕得不敢下來。我慢慢爬上去，把她抱回家。
那天晚上，我把每扇窗戶都關好。能把她找回來，我真的好開心！
